data.name: Interceptor
data.detailed_description:
Interceptor Unit: An autonomous hunter designed to track, intercept, and eliminate threats before they can spread. Deployed by the Barons when control begins to fail, Interceptors are relentless machines of pursuit - precise, tireless, and impossible to escape. When an Interceptor is sent, the hunt has already begun.

ABOUT

Step into the shadows of Furos, a forgotten human colony where degenerate machines sabotage crumbling infrastructure and darkness hides more than just enemies. Dispatched by the mighty Baron Nea, the Interceptor is the ultimate first-person enforcer, a lethal machine sent to restore order… but the truth lurking beneath the surface may change everything.

Beneath the rebellion of machines lies a deeper conspiracy: survivors of humanity, thought lost, manipulate events from the shadows. The Interceptor must navigate haunting corridors, hidden threats, and the fearsome legacy of the Nea, a powerful lineage born from humanity’s hubris, whose history is written in extinction and vengeance.

  • Precision FPS Combat: Engage rogue machines with calculated, lethal gunplay. Every shot counts.

  • Survival and Exploration: Scavenge tools and resources in derelict installations to survive deadly encounters.

  • Investigate the Void: Hack terminals, scan data logs, and uncover the hidden rebellion.

  • Horror Atmosphere: Navigate tense, eerie environments where danger can strike from any shadow.

The fragile peace of the planetary system hangs by a thread. On Furos, the Interceptor will discover that the past the Nea tried to bury refuses to stay dead.

NEA - NEANDERTHALS

After the fall of humanity, power in the system passed to the Nea, resurrected Neanderthals. The history between these two species is scarred by extinction and deep distrust. Long ago, Man challenged nature itself, but playing God ended in tragedy, turning creation against its creator.

Today, the Nea Barons stand guard over a fragile peace. Determined to rule with an iron fist, they are sworn to never allow the rebirth of the species whose ambition led to catastrophe.
